SELECT n.id, n.user_id, u.username, u.avatar, n.title, n.note_type, n.location_or_url, n.summary, n.cover_image, n.view_count as viewCount, n.is_pinned as isPinned, n.is_public as isPublic, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM t_note_item n LEFT JOIN t_user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.is_deleted = 0
AND (n.is_public = 1 OR n.user_id = #{currentUserId})
AND n.is_public = 1
AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.location_or_url LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY n.is_pinned DESC, n.updated_at DESC

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, u.username, n.title, n.note_type, n.location_or_url, n.summary, n.cover_image, n.view_count as viewCount, n.is_public as isPublic, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM t_note_item n LEFT JOIN t_user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.is_public = 1 ORDER BY n.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
